qualifications: The prefactor f is any total computable positive integer-valued function of the solution budget k. The exponent h is computable and nonnegative integer-valued.
There is a computable function T such that h(t) ≤ η max(t, 1) whenever t ≥ T(η), for each positive rational η.

reader.label: Effective little-o bound in the treewidth

sources.locator: Lemma 14, pp. 81:11–81:12. For clique size ℓ, the cover budget is ℓ(ℓ−1)/2 and the universe has size ℓ^O(1) log n.

Proof of Corollary 12, p. 6:14. Apply the red-blue construction to the incidence graph, with sets blue. A hub adjacent to all sets and a private leaf increase the budget by one. After rejecting uncovered elements, the graph is connected and bipartite. The universe together with the hub is a vertex cover, so treewidth is at most the universe size plus one. Effective sublinearity then absorbs the treewidth exponent into an FPT running time for Clique.
